about_the_game:
Set in the atmosphere of Eastern European folklore, Awakeroots blends elements of survival, strategy, and RPG.
You’ll take on the role of a settler and pioneer in a mysterious land where nature and magic intertwine.

🧱 Build and expand your settlement
Start with nothing and grow a thriving village. Construct homes, workshops, storage buildings, and defensive walls.

🌾 Cultivate the land
Plant, care for, and harvest crops using traditional methods. Your harvest may be your lifeline—or your greatest asset.

🛡️ Fortify and defend
Prepare for danger from all sides. Strengthen your walls, set traps, and defend your people from what lurks beyond.

👹 Battle Slavic mythological beasts
Face creatures pulled from ancient legends—Leshy, Rusalka, Poludnica and more—haunting the forests and forgotten ruins.

🌲 Explore the wilds
Venture through mysterious lands—dense forests, swamps, mountains, and sacred ruins. Discover relics, hidden lore, and secrets of ancient tribes.

🎨 Hand-crafted 2D art style
A unique visual identity shaped by one of the creators, inspired by folk patterns and traditional Slavic ornamentation.

🧬 The spirit of the ancestors, the power of roots

Awakeroots is a passion project—crafted by two brothers who combine creativity with a deep love for Slavic culture and storytelling.
It’s not just a game—it’s a journey into a world that could have been… and now awakens again.
